facades.aperture_ray_scope: Front-facing scan triangles between the actual glass pane and each patch's declared ahead clipping depth; native structures beyond that local volume remain authoritative.

oblique_sightlines.scope: Native scan geometry only: retained surfaces outside the declared reconstruction prisms are reported, not deleted or treated as local aperture failures.
oblique_sightlines.limitation: Preserved foreground terrain can still obscure upper windows from some views. These rays do not prove full facade visibility or reproduce Unity rendering.

roof_support.scope: Native roof geometry and static runtime support metadata; no Unity physics or character landing test.

visual_source_fragment_preservation.scope: Exact original triangle indices for unowned faces plus four barycentric samples per clipped face outside the declared volume union; not an exhaustive image proof.

limitations: The rebuilt floor/facade areas and confirmed green patches cover part of the supplied island, not the entire map.
Source color and elevation masks are conservative placement heuristics, not proof that every surface is natural ground.
Preserved native terrain outside facade reconstruction prisms can obscure upper windows; the 4 m oblique sightline report records that remaining visibility gap.
The new roof BoxCollider is checked as a source/geometry contract; Unity physics, landing and teardown still need Play Mode verification.
Native source checks do not execute Unity, test alpha overdraw, certify collision/camera behavior or establish reference-game visual parity.
